objective: Reparar exclusivamente ESTELAR 2025-06-12 con el backfill canonico corregido por R73. Idempotente. Escribir solo si pasa OK_HEADER_CANONICO. No tocar Runtime, Sync_Sales, Finanzas_CortesCaja, reportes certificados ni Produccion.

queries.name: estelar_20250612_post
queries.sql: WITH rt AS (SELECT CAST(fecha_operacion AS date) fecha, SUM(CAST(ISNULL(ventas_total,0) AS decimal(19,4))) ventas, SUM(CAST(ISNULL(tickets_total,0) AS bigint)) tickets, SUM(CAST(ISNULL(pax_total,0) AS bigint)) pax FROM dbo.vw_Comercial_KPIs_Diarios_v2_Runtime WHERE unidad_negocio_id='ESTELAR' AND fecha_operacion>='2025-06-12' AND fecha_operacion<'2025-06-13' GROUP BY CAST(fecha_operacion AS date)), dt AS (SELECT CAST(fecha_operacion AS date) fecha, numero_ticket, SUM(CAST(ISNULL(importe_neto,0) AS decimal(19,4))) venta_ticket, MAX(CAST(ISNULL(pax,0) AS bigint)) pax_ticket FROM dbo.Comercial_Inteligencia_VentasDetalleProducto WHERE unidad_negocio_id='ESTELAR' AND fecha_operacion>='2025-06-12' AND fecha_operacion<'2025-06-13' AND ISNULL(activo,1)=1 AND ISNULL(es_kpi_valido,1)=1 GROUP BY CAST(fecha_operacion AS date),numero_ticket), d AS (SELECT fecha,SUM(venta_ticket) ventas,COUNT(*) tickets,SUM(pax_ticket) pax FROM dt GROUP BY fecha) SELECT rt.fecha,rt.ventas AS ventas_runtime,ISNULL(d.ventas,0) AS ventas_detalle,rt.tickets AS tickets_runtime,ISNULL(d.tickets,0) AS tickets_detalle,rt.pax AS pax_runtime,ISNULL(d.pax,0) AS pax_detalle FROM rt LEFT JOIN d ON d.fecha=rt.fecha
